definitions.explanation: An organism that lived in a past geological age, now known primarily through fossil remains. Encompasses everything from ancient bacteria to dinosaurs.

examples.japanese: {古生物|こせいぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{化石|かせき}→化石：11796_kaseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Fossils of ancient organisms were discovered.

examples.english: I've been interested in prehistoric life since I was a child.

notes:
Combines {古|こ} (ancient) with ⟦{生物|せいぶつ}→生物：03295_seibutsu⟧ (living thing). Refers to any organism from the geological past, typically studied through fossils.
